parameters.query:
SELECT
 (SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'alerts') AS alerts,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND lead_kind <> 'trade')::int AS new_leads,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE status = 'New' AND coalesce(fit_score, 0) >= 70 AND lead_kind <> 'trade')::int AS strong,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE lead_kind = 'trade' AND status = 'New' AND trade_match IS NOT NULL)::int AS trade_matches,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM outreach WHERE status = 'draft')::int AS drafts,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM replies WHERE handled = false)::int AS replies,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE done = false AND due_at <= now() + interval '1 day')::int AS tasks_due,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM deals WHERE stage NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled'))::int AS open_deals,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT title, source, fit_score FROM leads WHERE status = 'New' AND lead_kind <> 'trade' ORDER BY coalesce(fit_score, 0) DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 3) t) AS top
INSERT INTO jobs (type, payload) VALUES ('send_alert', $1::jsonb) RETURNING id
